nodes.name: goal_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the autonomous goal-loop feature: persists GoalState, evaluates turn-end via an LLM judge, parses judge verdicts, and enqueues continuation messages until the goal is satisfied.

nodes.name: init_schema
nodes.summary: Initializes the database schema/tables used to persist goal-loop state.

nodes.name: load_state
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted GoalState for a session from the database.

nodes.name: save_state
nodes.summary: Persists the current GoalState for a session to the database.

nodes.name: on_user_message
nodes.summary: Hook invoked when a user sends a message, used to detect and record a new goal for the goal-loop feature.

nodes.name: parse_judge_verdict
nodes.summary: Parses the raw LLM judge response text into a structured JudgeVerdict (continue/stop decision and reasoning).

nodes.name: build_judge_messages
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt messages sent to the LLM judge to evaluate whether the current turn satisfied the stated goal.

nodes.name: spawn_turn_end_evaluation
nodes.summary: Spawns an asynchronous task that evaluates the end of a turn against the active goal without blocking the main session loop.

nodes.name: evaluate_turn_end
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether the just-completed turn satisfies the active goal, invoking the LLM judge and deciding whether to continue or stop the goal loop.

nodes.name: run_judge
nodes.summary: Runs the LLM judge side-query to obtain a verdict on the current goal-loop turn.

nodes.name: session_has_pending_messages
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session has pending/queued user messages, used to avoid auto-continuing the goal loop over a user who is mid-typing.

nodes.name: enqueue_continuation
nodes.summary: Enqueues a synthetic continuation message to keep the goal loop running for another turn, up to the configured max-turns limit.

nodes.name: broadcast_goal_event
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a goal-loop status event (progress, turns used, message) to the frontend over the event bus.

nodes.name: GoalState
nodes.summary: Persisted state for the goal-loop feature on a session: the active goal text, turns used, and status.

nodes.name: JudgeVerdict
nodes.summary: Structured verdict returned by the LLM judge evaluating whether a goal-loop turn satisfied the goal (continue/stop plus reasoning).

nodes.name: GoalLoopTurnEnd
nodes.summary: Input bundle describing the state at the end of a turn, passed to the goal-loop evaluation logic.

nodes.name: summarization.rs
nodes.summary: Builds LLM summarization prompts from conversation history and drives summarize_messages/summarize_messages_forked via a side-query to produce compaction summaries, with validation of the returned summary.

nodes.name: truncate_for_summary
nodes.summary: Truncates arbitrary text to a maximum character length before including it in a summarization prompt.

nodes.name: flatten_content_text
nodes.summary: Flattens a structured message content block into a single plain-text string for summarization purposes.

nodes.name: format_messages_for_summary_refs
nodes.summary: Formats the conversation history into a compact textual representation used as input to the summarization prompt.

nodes.name: format_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Formats a message's tool calls into readable text for inclusion in the summarization prompt.

nodes.name: build_summary_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the full LLM prompt used to request a conversation summary, optionally including custom instructions and the prior summary for continuity.

nodes.name: validate_summary
nodes.summary: Validates an LLM-produced summary for completeness (e.g., checking finish_reason and output length against the configured cap).

nodes.name: summarize_messages_forked
nodes.summary: Runs LLM summarization for the forked-compaction path, issuing a side-query against the given provider and returning the summary result.

nodes.name: summarize_messages
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that summarizes a message history via an LLM side-query, applying the configured token budget and custom instructions.

nodes.name: ForkSummaryInputs
nodes.summary: Bundled inputs (messages, state, model) required to run the forked-compaction summarization path.

nodes.name: resolved.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw AgentDefinition plus session overrides and integrations config into a fully-resolved ResolvedAgent runtime configuration, including tool selection and skills parameters.

nodes.name: skills_from_schema
nodes.summary: Converts a schema-level AgentSkillsConfig into resolved SkillsParams used at runtime.

nodes.name: SkillsParams
nodes.summary: Resolved runtime parameters controlling which skills are available to an agent and how they're loaded.

nodes.name: ResolvedToolSelection
nodes.summary: Fully-resolved tool allow/deny selection for an agent, derived from schema-level AgentToolSelection via from_schema().

nodes.name: ResolveError
nodes.summary: Error type returned when agent definition resolution fails (e.g., missing parent, invalid reference).

nodes.name: ResolvedAgent
nodes.summary: Fully-resolved runtime configuration for an agent, combining its definition, session overrides, and integrations config, with a resolve() constructor and workspace() accessor.

nodes.name: compaction.rs
nodes.summary: Core context-window compaction engine (ContextCompactor) implementing trigger detection, adaptive keep-ratio calculation, forked/manual compaction attempts, summary acceptance, and prompt-too-long recovery/calibration.

nodes.name: CompactionConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the compaction engine (trigger ratio, keep ratio, summary token budget, minimum messages, floor/reserved/buffer tokens), with defaults and an effective_budget() calculation.

nodes.name: CompactionState
nodes.summary: Tracks the current compaction-related state of a session (e.g., last compacted index, recompaction info).

nodes.name: RecompactionInfo
nodes.summary: Metadata describing a prior recompaction event, used to decide whether/how to recompact.

nodes.name: CompactionOutcome
nodes.summary: Result type describing the outcome of a compaction attempt (success, boundaries, token counts, or failure reason).

nodes.name: ContextCompactor
nodes.summary: Core compaction engine: detects when compaction is needed (needs_compaction*), performs standard/forked/manual compaction attempts (compact, compact_with_fork, compact_manual_force, try_compact), accepts LLM-produced summaries, and recovers from prompt-too-long errors via budget calibration and truncation.

nodes.name: fork.rs
nodes.summary: Implements attempt_fork, which forks session state during compaction by writing a new session record/file rather than mutating history in place.

nodes.name: attempt_fork
nodes.summary: Attempts to fork the current session during compaction: writes a new forked session record so compaction can proceed without mutating the original session's history in place.

nodes.name: build_forked_record
nodes.summary: Builds the new session record metadata for a forked session, linking it back to the original session id.

nodes.name: ForkOutcome
nodes.summary: Result type describing the outcome of a fork attempt (success with new session id, or failure reason).

nodes.name: ForkInputs
nodes.summary: Bundled inputs required to attempt a session fork (original session id, messages, compaction context).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the definitions subsystem that re-exports builtin agents, capabilities, commands, orgs, patch, prefix lookup, resolved/resolver, schema, and store submodules.

nodes.name: prefix_lookup.rs
nodes.summary: Provides lookup helpers that map session IDs to builtin agent definition prefixes, including workspace-personal and wingman session detection.

nodes.name: session_prefix_for_launch
nodes.summary: Determines the session id prefix to use when launching a session for a given agent definition, factoring in whether a workspace path is present.

nodes.name: BuiltinPrefixEntry
nodes.summary: Maps a builtin agent definition id to its session-id prefix convention.

nodes.name: cleanup.rs
nodes.summary: Performs post-compaction cleanup of stale tool-call state by collecting and clearing tool_call_ids no longer referenced in the trimmed message history.

nodes.name: post_compact_cleanup
nodes.summary: Cleans up tool-call bookkeeping state after a compaction pass by removing entries for tool_call_ids no longer present in the trimmed message history.

nodes.name: collect_tool_call_ids
nodes.summary: Walks a message list and collects the set of tool_call_ids referenced within it, used to determine which tool-call state entries are still live.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the session compaction subsystem, re-exporting fork, manual, and persist submodules.
